interpretation_by_outcome.baseline_predictive_success: Support for adequacy on prespecified outcomes in this cohort, conditional on useful precision; not absence of inheritance.
interpretation_by_outcome.alternative_predictive_improvement: Extra predictive structure within tested models; not uniquely memory, causality or a therapeutic target.
interpretation_by_outcome.imprecise_comparison: Inconclusive; failure to reject is not equivalence.
interpretation_by_outcome.reconstruction_failure: Useful documentation and missing-data requirements; no empirical hazard inference from unresolved identities.

minimum_analysis_gate: Reconcile candidate episodes, repeated ancestry and source founder roster before defining denominators.
Separate administrative censoring from unknown losses and absent daughter branches; complete-follow-up selection must not silently replace the target cohort.
Freeze time origin, eligibility, model flexibility, likelihood, score, split and practical precision/tolerance criteria before fitting.
Keep all descendants and resampled paths of each founder in one partition and one uncertainty cluster.
Handle delayed entry and observable never-dividers explicitly; no outcome-dependent exclusions disguised as missingness.
Test held-out predictions, not the Qh accounting identity; avoid tuning on test founders.
Without replicate identifiers, restrict conclusions to the recorded cohort.

resource_audit_findings.finding: Two consecutive commitments repeat the same sensitivity list; retain the more complete one if edited.
Specify practical predictive adequacy and useful precision before interpreting a negative model comparison.

Structural reconstruction is being refined; no provisional root or issue counts are used as evidence of a data limitation. Outcome inference requires a verified event graph and eligible-founder cohort.
